headline: Pakistan Stock Exchange KSE-100 Surges Nearly 1,200 Points in Early Trade
summary: Buying in commercial banking, fertilizer, and energy stocks pushed the benchmark KSE-100 Index up 1,177 points, or 0.66%, to 178,560.03 during morning trading at the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
why: The KSE-100 index tracks major listed companies on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, serving as the country's main financial indicator.

impacts.name: KSE-100
impacts.why: Broad-based institutional buying in key sectors lifted Pakistan's main stock index.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong buyer demand in blue-chip banking and oil exploration shares drove index gains.
